sloka: को ऽयं कस्य कुतो वा ऽत्र किं कार्यं को व्यपाश्रयः ।इति राक्षसवीराणां तत्र संजज्ञिरे कथाः ।। ५.४८.५६।।।।
transliteration: ko 'yaṁ kasya kuto vā 'tra kiṁ kāryaṁ ko vyapāśrayaḥ ।iti rākṣasavīrāṇāṁ tatra saṁjajñire kathāḥ ।। 5.48.56।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter other ogres angrily said 'Let us kill him, burn him or otherwise devour him,' thus they spoke to one another.
